sentences.en: We must get rid of this foul garbage right away.
sentences.zh: 我们必须立刻清除这股恶臭的垃圾。

sentences.en: It is an ill bird that fouls its own nest.
sentences.zh: 害群之马才会自毁前程。

sentences.en: He was fouled by Leonardo Bonucci earning a free kick.
sentences.zh: 莱昂纳多· Bonucci 犯规了，对方因此获得了一个间接任意球。

senses.zh: 犯规的；邪恶的；污秽的；淤塞的
犯规；弄脏；淤塞；缠住，妨害
